note: Attacker-controlled input bytes (including 0x80 non-printable byte) are passed to gnutls_idna_map
Input contains 0x80 which is non-printable, so the early-return path is skipped
Input is copied to a NULL-terminated buffer istr
idn2_to_ascii_8z (idn2_lookup_u8) is called with the input string
idn2_lookup_u8 calls _tr46 with the input since IDN2_NO_TR46 is not set
Label 'xn--a' starts with 'xn--' prefix, so punycode decode path is taken
Punycode part 'a' is converted to UTF-8 bytes in ace buffer
Punycode decode is called with uninitialized name_u32 output array

code: int punycode_decode(size_t input_length, const char input[], size_t *output_length, punycode_uint output[])
note: Entry to punycode_decode with uninitialized output array name_u32

code: memmove(output + i + 1, output + i, (out - i) * sizeof *output)
note: memmove reads from output array which may contain uninitialized values, causing MSAN use-of-uninitialized-value
